title: Ownership Manager

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Transfers or removes ownership of items based on power input. Will only work with your own items.

body:
"Allows you to clear & transfer ownership of items! Providing a power input of 10.0 will clear the ownership of items, and providing a user id will transfer the ownership to that player."

The Ownership Manager is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It changes ownership of items.

Functionality

The Ownership Manager can remove ownership or transfer ownership of items freely, but only one at a time. The probe in front of it is purely decorational, as well as the case with the Interactor, as you now select a range/area of an item that will have its ownership changed. However, to change or remove ownership of items in a range, any and all items within the range must be owned by you, either causing, or having the problem of it only being able to change the ownership of one item at a time(May change in a later update, not fixed as of 1.66.2). To remove ownership, the Ownership Manager requires a signal of 10.0.

However, to change ownership of an item to another player, the required signal must be the player ID of the player you wish to transfer item ownership to, making it very ineffective to change ownership to other players in this way, as it would require a number interface(orthodoxically).

Trivia

As Roblox IDs are 64 bit integers, this means that any accounts with a user ID that are, or greater than 10*10^14 or, 15 or more digits long, they will not be able to have ownership transferred to them, at least not very easily through the same number interface method, as number interfaces can only output 14 digits of signal, or, up to 999,999,999,999,999.
